derivation.join: the legacy development fixture joined to the canonical case by the ordered content keys of the parity report (sha256(content)|expected spans|fixture name, then looser), one to one, and the occurrence bytes equal (legacy evidence.input.contentHash = canonical variant content_digest)
derivation.occurrence: canonical case, variant, peer scanner and disagreement property; the occurrence id itself is never compared

note: Product-owned, generated by npm run qualification:ledger-rekey; never hand-edited. Maps a canonical differential occurrence of the pinned methods run to the legacy review-ledger entry made for the same case, peer and disagreement property; the legacy ledger stays the source of every decision. An unmapped occurrence is unreviewed.
